messages:
sam: Morning — quick async for the day. What I did: pushed the route-map PR for /v2/model-routing (adds fallback to small-latency pool). Blockers: need confirmation on the X-Rate-Limit-Policy header semantics from infra and the canary window timing. Today: address CR feedback and wire up canary wiring.

rachel: skimmed the PR, left 2 inline comments about header parsing and an edge-case for missing header. quick snippet suggestion: `if (req.headers['x-rate-limit-policy'] === 'strict') { /* enforce */ } else { /* default */ }` — tiny nit but prevents fallback confusion.

miguel: quick Q — are we still rotating JWT KIDs on a short cadence? my staging tests started failing after last deploy, seeing 401s in the dedup worker. @kevin any idea?

kevin: i toggled the key-rotation flag yesterday for a narrow test, might be related. i reverted it on staging ~10m ago. miguel, can you re-run your e2e and paste the failing log if it repros?

miguel: pasted failing snippet:
```
error: auth.verify failed kid=null token=eyJhbGci... status=401
context: dedup-worker / ingest -> auth-service
stack: AuthError: no matching key id
```
will rerun now.

anya: blocker for me: I can’t access the canary pool metrics in Console — hitting 403 on the dedicated-pools page. prob RBAC, assigned to ppl-ops to escalate.

ppl-ops-bot: created ticket #2345 to investigate RBAC on dedicated-pools; assigned to @ops-eng. ETA 2h.

deploy-bot: Canary started for commit abc123 -> gw-routing-service (10% traffic). Monitoring window set to 15m, alerts wired to #incidents and oncall.

sam: ack, will watch latency dashboards and token breakdown. If 429s spike we’ll fallback to default pool via the new policy.

rachel: quick distro question on rate-limit algorithm: prefer token-bucket for short bursts or leaky-bucket for smoothing? my vote :+1: token-bucket (bursty UX better).

kevin: token-bucket + per-route cap seems right for gateway. i’ll add a short rationale to the PR so reviewers see the tradeoffs.

miguel: rerun passed after kevin revert — e2e green now, dedup-worker auth ok. unblocked for me.

sam: great — sounds like we’re mostly unblocked. i’ll address rachel’s comments and queue for one more review, then merge and monitor the canary. thanks all.
